title: A guard refuses a posted review record whose Head is not the PR's live head
why: Incident about 15:10 CST Nov 7: lane notes-fix-page posted a review record on #1475 with a hand-typed wrong head tail.
note: The guard refuses a GitHub comment post whose body holds the review-record marker unless the record's Head is the PR's live head and its PR line names the target PR. Topic review-rounds. Guard change, full review rounds. Red test first.
